name: B10-0063/2025 (The Left) – Systematic repression of human rights in Iran, notably the cases of Pakhshan Azizi and Wrisha Moradi, and the taking of EU citizens as hostages
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the systematic repression of human rights in Iran, notably the cases of Pakhshan Azizi and Wrisha Moradi, and the taking of EU citizens as hostages
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Iran to cancel the death sentences against two Kurdish women activists, Pakhshan Azizi and Wrisha Moradi, and to give them a fair retrial. It condemns Iran's growing use of executions, including against minorities, and its practice of holding foreign and dual nationals as bargaining chips. It asks Iran to allow lawyers, consular visits and medical care for detainees, and to stop using torture. It also urges European Union countries to offer more humanitarian visas to persecuted women and rights defenders.

- The Parliament asks Iran to cancel two death sentences and retry the cases; the two women are affected.
- It demands fair trials, lawyers and medical care for detainees, including foreign nationals held as hostages.
- It urges European Union states to give more humanitarian visas; no binding change follows.
